interface.Bar: Bar(timestamp: aware UTC datetime or integer epoch-minute; open, high, low, close: integer 0.25-point ticks)
interface.simulate_day: simulate_day(bars, session_date: date or ISO date, fee_per_side: Decimal USD or integer cents=100, friction_ticks: frozen1/2/4=2, calendar_status=REGULAR) -> JSON-serializable dict
interface.calendar_status: REGULAR is caller attestation of independent exchange-calendar verification; SHORTENED/CLOSED exclude; UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE unresolved.
interface.money: Exact two-decimal USD strings; one contract at$0.50/tick; unresolved full-outcome gross/fees/net null; known entry fee retained inside open trade.
interface.exit_times: exit_timestamp is exact modeled open for OPEN basis, or start of minute interval for INTRABAR_INTERVAL with exit_interval_end; no intrabar fill timestamp inferred.
interface.coverage: Incremental scheduled UTC slots grouped by required phase; stops at first incomplete phase or terminal decision. required_missing lists known missing required slots, not a manufactured whole-day checklist.

limitations: OHLC execution approximation does not prove actual tradability, exchange queue fills, spread/slippage, fees or latency.
Only predeclared sensitivity costs accepted; actual independent cost evidence and operating costs remain runner/report responsibilities.
Caller must verify contract identity, timestamp start convention, regular calendar, licensing, exact dataset hashes/date splits and actual-versus-proxy provenance before any result claims.
Input validates all supplied rows, including later irrelevant rows; malformed rows raise ValueError/TypeError instead of producing a trade decision.
Unknown calendar status can be unresolved without missing bar timestamps; coverage.complete remains false.
No production deployment, live orders, broker/config imports, network calls, paid purchase, old holdout or TEST access performed.
